title: Open a 2D space, zoom and pan
summary: Open a 2D space as a drawing and move around it with the wheel, the zoom controls, Fit drawing, the Pan tool and Space.
roles: Anyone who can open the project

training.topic: Finding your way around a 2D space

title: The drawing toolbar and the formatting bar
summary: The three rows above the 2D space: what to add, the editing tools, and text and line formatting.
roles: Everyone sees it; editing needs edit rights on the drawing

training.topic: A tour of the drawing toolbar

title: Snap, Grid and Ortho
summary: Turn the grid, snapping onto nozzles and horizontal-or-vertical lines on and off, kept per person.
roles: Everyone; the setting is per person

title: Place a symbol
summary: Place equipment, valves and instruments from the Add asset window; each symbol becomes a new object with its next free name or tag.
roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

title: Add other objects with the Object button
summary: Make unit operations, systems, processes and areas from the drawing toolbar's Object type menu.
roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

training.topic: The Object button and its types

title: Draw pipes, signals and cables with Connector
summary: Draw flow lines, cables, wires and logic signals point by point; every line is an object that connects what it touches.
roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

title: Connection rules: one pipe per nozzle, lines that follow and heal
summary: A nozzle takes one pipe end, lines follow moved symbols, and deleting an inline symbol joins the line again.
roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

title: Select symbols, lines and notes
summary: Select with a click, Shift-click or Ctrl-click, a frame, a double-click on a run, or Select all.
roles: Anyone who can open the project

title: Move, flip, resize and align
summary: Move symbols with their lines, flip them, resize them with grips and align, distribute or match their size.
roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

title: Undo, redo, copy, paste and duplicate
summary: Copy, paste and duplicate make new objects with new tags; undo and redo work step by step across the project.
roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

training.topic: Copy, paste and undo on the drawing

title: Delete on the drawing: the placement or the object
summary: Remove a symbol from this drawing only, or delete its object to the Deleted bin.
roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

title: Tags, names and line numbers on the 2D space
summary: Symbols show their tags, pipe runs their line numbers; drag and rotate the labels and tag a symbol with the Tag tool.
roles: Everyone sees labels; moving them and tagging need edit rights

training.topic: Tags and line numbers on the 2D space

title: Text notes and text formatting
summary: Place text notes and format notes and symbol names: font, colour, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, size and rotation.
roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

title: Line style, thickness and colour
summary: Set a selected line's thickness, colour and solid or dashed pattern.
roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

title: Flow arrows, flow direction and line crossings
summary: Flow arrows show the direction of flow lines; flip a line's direction, and choose gaps or line jumps at crossings.
roles: Editor license; the crossing style needs a role that may change project settings

title: Highlight flow
summary: Trace where a line's or a symbol's flow goes, optionally through pumps and compressors and across 2D spaces.
roles: Anyone who can open the project

title: Layers
summary: Hide process, instrumentation, electrical or annotation content of a 2D space for yourself.
roles: Everyone; the setting is per person and per 2D space

title: System and area frames
summary: Draw a rectangle, circle or freehand frame so the symbols inside belong to a system or area.
roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

title: Off-page connectors and Continue on 2D space
summary: Carry a line to other 2D spaces with off-page connectors: link them end to end or let one continue on several, jump between them, and disconnect; Highlight flow and Alex follow the links.
roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

training.topic: Off-page connectors: linking and continuing on other 2D spaces

title: The right-click menus on the 2D space, and Replace
summary: The grouped right-click menus of symbols, lines and empty spots, and Replace, which swaps a symbol and keeps the object.
roles: Everyone; editing items need edit rights

title: Chat here: pin a message on the drawing
summary: Pin a chat message on a symbol; the object needs review until the message is resolved.
roles: Anyone who may write in the chat in the project

training.topic: Chat messages pinned on the drawing

title: ISA 5.1 and ISO 10628 symbols
summary: Browse the shapes by standard in Configuration → Shapes and filter the Add asset window by standard.
roles: Everyone can browse

title: Drop an object from the explorer onto the 2D space or a line
summary: Drag an existing object from the explorer onto a 2D space; dropped on a pipe, it goes into the line.
roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

title: Predictive mode: Let Alex help
summary: Alex reviews the drawing as you work and offers the next symbols as ghosts, with an After your change card in the Alex tab to apply or reject, locally without the cloud.
roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

title: Engineering patterns
summary: Draw a redundant pump train, an instrument tap or a motor feeder at once, placed, routed and checked.
roles: Editor license; an AI model set up, and Let Alex get help from ticked

title: Generated loop diagrams
summary: Generate a control function's loop diagram from the model, move symbols by hand, and regenerate while keeping your moves.
roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit the project

title: Symbol designer and Modify shape…
summary: Draw your own symbols with their connection points and publish them, or adapt a placed symbol for one project with Modify shape….
roles: Project administrator (Modify shape…); Library administrator (company shapes)

title: Attribute labels on symbols
summary: Labels on a symbol that show an attribute value with its unit, always current, on the 2D space and in the PDF.
roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

title: SVG import into the symbol designer
summary: Import an SVG drawing as a shape draft: read safely, fitted into the shape, connection points suggested.
roles: Library administrator

title: Symbol versions on placements
summary: Placements keep the shape version they were placed with; Updates available lists them and upgrades them with a preview.
roles: Library administrator (publishes the new version); anyone who may edit drawings (upgrades placements)

title: Pipelines and completeness checks
summary: Group pipe runs into pipelines across 2D spaces, select them whole and find incomplete ones.
roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

title: Pipe classes
summary: Give each pipeline its piping specification: material, rating and allowed components.
roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

title: Pipe schedule (line list)
summary: A line list of the project's pipelines, kept up to date from the drawing.
roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

title: DEXPI exchange and handover
summary: Exchange P&IDs with other tools and hand them over in the DEXPI format.
roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

title: CAD import (DXF, later DWG)
summary: Import CAD drawings as a dimmed background layer to trace over.
roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

title: Redlining
summary: Mark up 2D spaces in review rounds on a separate Markups layer that never changes the drawing.
roles: Reviewers and editors
